logic: The frozen PLAN.json write_scope plus shared_files list does not include the existing ProductDatabase composition or its v37 child modules. Native H/F must enter the existing single verified DB/OwnerIssuer/ProcessCustodian composition. A wiring dependency does not itself authorize absent paths; the separate candidate-chain scope precedent explicitly preserves this distinction.
existing_branch_state: Earlier construction already changed these six unlisted paths for User ingress, instance login and seat/admission wiring. No separate authorization for these paths was found in repository scope receipts. This proposal neither treats that historical implementation as authorization nor discards it.

requested_changes.change: Minimal User dispatch and ownership/lifetime of H/F state on the existing composition; no raw DB/issuer accessors.
Owner-private instance/seat/source configuration; no service/model routing into this plane.
Same-store admission and logical-ID-only worktree/session entry; native E/F facts provide paths, pins and permissions.
Direct native integration and original-request/negative/restart tests for those entry points.
Keep existing actual pinned CLI login/account observation composition and direct errors; never read/copy credentials.
Cloud-only direct errors from the actual prepared CLI PID, absent from release builds; no acceptance inference.

preserved_boundaries: Bound design37 goal, contract families, permission tiers and authority model unchanged
One existing verified native DB, OwnerIssuer and ProcessCustodian; no copied DB or second authority
RootLock, E/F current identities, exact program bytes, LPAC/Job custody, original-request UNKNOWN fencing and stop facts
Test seats write only host-created isolated worktrees for the private gogoke-seat-testbed; no formal data, registration or shortcuts touched
No local native build, credential reads/copies, security-setting changes, code signing, public release, main merge or self acceptance

reviewable_wip.planned_behavior: Separate Owner source configuration observes/pins actual Git and source facts; closed K-WORKTREE create takes logical IDs, reads exact original outcome before any fresh Git operation, and refuses UNKNOWN or mismatched source/pin.

owner_action_needed: Authorize these exact six existing composition paths for the minimal authorized H/F/L0 delivery, or have Claude revise the plan and complete MANIFEST reauthorization. This does not request new product permissions or main merge authority.
not_done: No additional source implementation proceeds across this unresolved path boundary; M1 and OT4 readiness remain incomplete.
